HALLOWEEN EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat Eripmav!!
Oh, you made it here...Lemme introduce myself once\nagain. I'm the Crimson Moon Witch, Eripmav.\nWelcome everyone!
We didn't come here because we wanted to!\nGimme back my bag now!\nOh, and those 3 kids you kidnapped too!
Hey, the way you say it sounds as if we're not\nimportant at all!
Aren't you here to rescue us, pom?!
Aren't they your friends?
I don't have much confidence in the little girl...\nAnyway, why did you kidnap us?!
You were enjoying the festival tonight, weren't\nyou? I just wanna add some fun to the festival\nwith my own creativity.
So I decided to invite y'all.\nDon't y'all wannna feel the fun too?\nLike this, you see.
Oh, no, stop it please!
I don't like anything that scares me, pom!
Oh, this is somewhat fun too!
So? How long are you gonna keep this going?
For a few centuries maybe?
You've got to be kidding me!\nGimme my bag now!
I can't live without it!\nI really mean it financially! I repeat,\nfinancially!!
My goodness.\nWe'll get you out now..Hm?
D-don't tell me you're grandma?!
I didn't realize it was grandma, pom!
G-grandma?\nSo that means she is...
Grandma!\nThat was fun!
Oh, Olant, only you are cute after all.
Good grief...\nCan you please stop showing favoritism to your\ngrandchildren?
Grandma, you've always favored Olant and loved him\nonly.
W-what's going on here?
So? You mean you kidnapped them because you felt\nlonely as everyone was having fun and enjoying\nthe festival?
Uh, well, I mean...\nI've talked to Neewollah too about this before and\nhe didn't say anything, so...
But grandma, you usually sleep all the time and we\nnever know when you will wake up.
Besides, you don't treat your grandchildren\nequally. You only love Olant...
I-I can't help it!\nBecause he's the one who enjoys my hospitality\nthe most...
Grandma, it was fun too this time!
I see...\nThat's why you kidnapped him first.
Grandma, it's not that I don't like you, but I'm\nnot entertained by what you do.
I dunno why but only Olant likes it, pom.
Well, since grandpa was with me, we had explained\nthe situation to Zarth and Zoe together.
Okay, Eripmav.\nYou've had your fun, so this should be enough.
Well, yeah. It's been a while since I last moved\nmy body so much. Let's do this again next time!
When exactly will that be...
Oh, you came again?\nWhat is it...? Did you come to check on my\ngrandchildren in place of Zarth?
Jeez. I did pull a little prank on him when he\nmarried Zoe. Is he still holding a grudge over\nthat?
Anyway, why don't you play with me?\nThe last time I really had fun was when I played\nagainst Zarth. I'm gonna be serious too this time.
Oh, that was a good exercise!\nCome play with me again next time ♪

Oh, you came at the right time!
I've received some sweets from Zoe again, but\nwhen I asked Eripmav, she told me there were\nsweets with a more sophisticated flavor.
I think Zoe would be happy to receive the\ningredients to make them. But I'm kinda struggling\nto get them.
I've asked Jeila, Olant, and Potumkin too, but\nEripmav didn't allow them to help.
So, I'd like to ask you to help on behalf of\neveryone. What do you say?
Sure!
I'm busy now.
Yay! I knew you'd help! Okay, here's the memo of\nthe ingredients you need to collect! Thanks in\nadvance!
Oh no, you've come all the way to this world,\nthough. How could you say that?
Welp, I'm not gonna force you though...\nBut if you change your mind, please let me know!
How is it? Is it going well?
I see.\nSorry, we can't help you.\nKeep going then!
